cases.prompt: Make a Manhunt game: one hunter per three players, everyone shares GPS, the hunter tags a runner within 15 metres, and the hunter gets hot/cold hints.
Make a capture the flag game for two teams on foot. Each team has a home point on the map; carrying the enemy flag back to your home point scores. Use GPS positions.
Make a tag game in a shrinking GPS circle. Whoever is it passes the tag by getting within 10 metres of someone; players outside the circle are eliminated.
Make a hot potato party game: one player holds the potato, flicking the phone passes it to a random other player, and whoever holds it when the timer ends is out.
Make a two-player quick draw duel: after a random delay a cue plays and the first player to raise their phone wins the round; raising early loses it.
